products.name: ZonoSoft HR
products.tagline: Rotas, clocking in, payroll hours and staff records for managers.
info: ZonoSoft HR is for the manager. Plan the weekly rota and print it on one A4 page, book holiday and absence, see who's clocked in, check timesheets and send payroll hours to whoever does your pay. Keep each person's full record: documents and letters, sickness and sick pay, family leave, right to work, reviews, and disciplinary and grievance cases.
Your business's data stays in your own storage: on your PC, or shared through your own OneDrive, Google Drive or network folder, encrypted. ZonoSoft never sees it.
Needs a licence key (£12 a month including 5 team members), or a free demo key to try it first.

minimum: Needed for licence checks, updates and shared storage
recommended: Windows Hello (face or fingerprint) for quick sign-in; a printer for A4 rotas
setup: Download the installer and open it.
If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.
Follow the steps. You don't need to be an administrator, and nothing else needs installing.
Open ZonoSoft HR from the Start menu, create the first manager's login, then enter your licence or demo key in Settings, Licence.

minimum: Needed for licence checks, updates and shared storage
recommended: Tablet, or a 6-inch phone or larger
Fingerprint or face unlock for quick sign-in
setup: Download the .apk on the phone or tablet.
Open it. When asked, allow your browser to install apps.
Create the first manager's login, then enter your licence or demo key in Settings, Licence.

products.name: ZonoSoft HR Team
products.tagline: For team members: shifts, holiday requests, clocking in and their own details.
info: ZonoSoft HR Team is the app for your staff. Team members see their shifts, request holiday, clock in and out, check their own details and tell their manager when they're off sick.
It joins your business with a team code from the manager and only sees what each team member is allowed to see. It's free: team members are covered by the business's ZonoSoft HR licence.
Install it on a shared clocking-in PC or tablet, or on each team member's own phone.

minimum: Needed to reach your business's shared storage
recommended: 1920 × 1080, or a touch screen for clocking in
Windows Hello (face or fingerprint) for quick sign-in
setup: Download the installer and open it.
If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.
Follow the steps, then open ZonoSoft HR Team from the Start menu.
Enter the team code your manager gives you (it starts SFZ1-).

minimum: Needed to reach your business's shared storage
recommended: Fingerprint or face unlock for quick sign-in
setup: Open it. When asked, allow your browser to install apps.
Tap Install, then open ZonoSoft HR Team.
Enter the team code your manager gives you (it starts SFZ1-).
